zh.title: 雙十連假離島管制航線將於下週一開放訂位
zh.summary: 台灣交通部民用航空局宣布，2026年雙十節3天連假期間，澎湖、金門及馬祖三離島管制航線將提供1,102架次、共計89,926個座位數。相關機票將於8月10日上午9時起統一開放訂位。本次航空疏運期自10月8日至10月12日，為期5天，尖峰時段管制航線機票將加註使用限制。
body: 台灣交通部民用航空局於8月7日宣布，2026年雙十節連假澎湖、金門及馬祖三離島管制航線將於8月10日上午9時起開放訂位。本次雙十節共有3天連假，自10月9日至10月11日，民航局規劃10月8日至10月12日為5天的航空疏運期，呼籲有需求旅客儘早規劃。
民航局指出，本次疏運期間三離島航線共提供1,102架次、計89,926個座位。其中澎湖航線提供498架次、36,828個座位；金門航線提供470架次、44,018個座位；馬祖航線則提供134架次、9,080個座位。為確保運能效率，尖峰時段機票均會加註「限當日當班次」等使用限制。

en.title: Taiwan to Open Bookings for Double Tenth Holiday Flights to Offshore Islands on August 10
en.summary: Taiwan's Civil Aeronautics Administration announced that bookings for flights to Penghu, Kinmen, and Matsu during the 2026 Double Tenth Day holiday will open on August 10 at 9:00 AM. The air transportation period will run from October 8 to October 12, offering 1,102 flights and 89,926 seats. To ensure efficient travel during peak hours, tickets for these island routes will include specific restrictions, such as being valid only on the scheduled day and flight.
body: Taiwan's Civil Aeronautics Administration (CAA) announced on August 7, 2026, that ticket bookings for flights to Penghu, Kinmen, and Matsu during the Double Tenth Day holiday will open on August 10 at 9:00 AM. The holiday period runs from October 9 to October 11, with the official air transportation period set from October 8 to October 12, spanning five days.

A total of 1,102 flights and 89,926 seats will be available. The Penghu route offers 498 flights with 36,828 seats; the Kinmen route offers 470 flights with 44,018 seats; and the Matsu route provides 134 flights with 9,080 seats. During peak travel hours, tickets for these island flights will include strict usage restrictions, such as being valid only for the designated flight.
